unit_system: GeV for energies, GV for rigidity, m^2 sr s for exposure; c kept explicit in R = pc/(Ze)
energy_variable: declared per measurement: rigidity R (GV), kinetic energy per nucleon T/A (GeV/n) or energy E (GeV); every conversion states Z and A (or the mass)
frame: detector location (top of the instrument) unless a solar-modulation model is applied and stated
ams02:rigidity_definition: R = pc/(Ze) in GV; p = |Z|R/c; rigidity is not momentum
ams02:rigidity_sign: follows a convention stated by each analysis; this profile does not fix it
ams02:charge_sign_source: Tracker and magnet curvature only; TOF, TRD, ECAL and RICH do not measure charge sign
ams02:mass_number_assumption: elemental fluxes converted to T/A need a stated A or an isotope-composition model, whose uncertainty is part of the result
